convertibility_reason: Uses external custom signal library CCP_Stoch_M.mqh for trading logic; depends on MQL5 Standard Library Expert framework (CExpert, CExpertSignal) which has no Python equivalent; signal filter is a custom class with proprietary logic requiring manual reconstruction

other_exits: Signal-based close when CCP_Stoch reverse signal exceeds Signal_ThresholdClose (10); pending order expiration after 4 bars

position_sizing.conditional_logic: CMoneyFixedLot uses fixed lot size (0.1); Percent parameter (10%) sets risk fraction for margin validation but lot size is fixed

custom_logic_notes: EA uses MQL5 Standard Library CExpert framework with CExpertSignal threshold-based voting system. CCP_Stoch is a custom signal filter class that wraps Stochastic(33,37,30) with MA(25) confirmation - exact entry/exit logic inside CCP_Stoch_M.mqh is not visible here. Signal weight is 1.0. CExpertSignal.ThresholdOpen=10 and ThresholdClose=10 mean the weighted signal must exceed these thresholds. Expert_EveryTick=false means processing occurs once per bar (on new bar only). Pending orders expire after 4 bars. No trailing stop is applied (CTrailingNone).
python_conversion_notes: The CExpert framework's voting/threshold signal system must be reimplemented. The CCP_Stoch_M.mqh custom signal class is the core logic and must be reverse-engineered or sourced separately - it likely implements Stochastic crossover with MA filter. The threshold mechanism (open>=10, close>=10 with weight=1.0) means: long when Stoch signal votes +10 or more, short when -10 or less. SL/TP are in points (50 points = 5 pips on 5-digit broker, 50 pips on 4-digit). Pending order expiration of 4 bars must be tracked. The EveryTick=false flag simplifies conversion to bar-close logic. CMoneyFixedLot is straightforward - always use 0.1 lots regardless of equity. No digit adjustment logic is present in this file but may exist inside the custom signal library.
